I think Zillah´s Tears is a good card because of it´s potential to "pre-load" an effect. This allows to concentrate more effects than usual in a certain time frame, good for making lunges which are sometimes the only way to score a VP. Say you have an aggressive predator and three minions, so you can´t afford to tap out. You can tap one and play ZT in turn X and bleed for one or so. Then you can probably tap everyone in turn X+1, because you have that untap ready in addition to the ones in your hand.

Also see what Orian has to say about it, he calls it "the acceleration turn".
ttcmaster.blogspot.de/2013_09_01_archive.html
